           FRANCISCEA UNIFLORA

         Manaca

        (FRACISCEA)


Chronic stiffness of the muscles. Gonorrhœal rheumatism. Syphilis and
        rheumatism, great heat over body, much aching, better sweat. Pain in back of head and spine;
        band-like feeling around head. Pericarditis with rheumatism. Rheumatic pains in feet and
        lower part of legs. Urine contains uric acid.



Dose.--  Tincture of Fluid Extract 10 to 60 minims.
